evals.expected_output: Runs the full pipeline: detect → explore → generate → arch → reports → verify.
expectations: Runs all five steps in pipeline order, plus the optional reports phase when yry-report is present
Shares a single pipelineState object across steps
Halts on any step failure (no silent retries)

evals.prompt: Re-run /yry-init — I want a full rebuild of CLAUDE.md.
evals.expected_output: Rewrites CLAUDE.md in full, regenerates the docs home, and preserves the README domain-language section.
expectations: Rebuilds README.md but preserves the domain-language section

evals.prompt: Run the detect step only against cwd.
evals.expected_output: Probes the filesystem and emits a profile baseline.
expectations: Probes filesystem for the profile baseline

evals.prompt: Explore the source and emit a module map + conventions.
evals.expected_output: Runs 02-explore and emits an Exploration (module map, conventions, security surface).

evals.prompt: Generate the docs home and the two story directories.
evals.expected_output: 03-generate emits CLAUDE.md, README.md, docs home; 04-arch emits docs/arch/ and docs/test/.
expectations: All generated artifacts live under docs/

evals.expected_output: Runs 05-verify: 7-point readiness check + engineering gate, emits { result, failures }.
expectations: Terminates the pipeline on verify failure

evals.prompt: The yry-report skill isn't installed — what happens to the reports phase?
evals.expected_output: Skips the reports phase non-blocking, records pipelineState.reports = { result: 'skipped' }, continues to verify.
expectations: Continues to 05-verify (does not fail the pipeline)

evals.prompt: The reports orchestrator script exited non-zero — what now?
evals.expected_output: Sets pipelineState.reports = { result: 'fail', stderr } and lets 05-verify surface it; no retry.

evals.prompt: 05-verify returned fail — should the pipeline continue?
evals.expected_output: Terminates the pipeline and surfaces the failure list with fix suggestions.
expectations: Terminates the pipeline on verify fail

evals.prompt: Where does the docs home layout come from?
evals.expected_output: Explains the layout source of truth is yry-init/templates/ (skill root); only the data model is regenerated.
expectations: Cites yry-init/templates/ as the layout source of truth
Notes that only the data model is regenerated
Flags layout drift as a verify failure
